name: muza-monorepo
description: MUZA - AI-Powered Content Management and Social Media Publishing Platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@muza/shared && npm run build --workspace=@muza/database && npm run build --workspace=@muza/integrations && npm run build --workspace=@muza/queues && npm run build --workspace=@muza/ai
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@muza/api
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@muza/worker
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=@muza/shared && npm run build --workspace=@muza/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@muza/api && npm run build --workspace=@muza/worker && npm run build --workspace=@muza/web
